summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  ### What I already audited (read-only, no changes made) - `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` — loads lists via `GET /watchlist`, no localStorage/anonymous fallback for watchlist data (only theme uses localStorage). - `client/src/lib/api.ts` — all fetches use `credentials: "include"`, so the session cookie is sent correctly. - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` — every route is behind its own inline auth middleware (lines 13-21) that resolves the session cookie/bearer token via `getSession()` and injects `X-User-Id`; eve
